paite: Huai zoh in Agrippa in Paul kiang ah, "Na siamna thu na gen thei," achi hi. Huan Paul in akhut avan a, asiamna thu agen hi.
heading: Agrippa Ma A Paul Thugen

paite: "Kumpipa Agrippa, Judate'n ahon hekna tengteng uah ka siamna thu gen ding a tuni a na ma a ka din theih hampha ka kisa hi.
Judate tawndan leh pupa ngeinate theisiam leh pil mahmah na hih ziak in ka kipak tuanse hi. Huaiziak in thuakzoutak in ka thugen hon ngaihkhiaksak ding in ka hon ngen hi.
"Ka tuailai hun a kipan ka chipihte lak leh Jerusalem a ka omdan Judate tengteng in athei uhi.
Atung a kipan a ka tanchin theite ahi ua, huchi a ka sabiakdan ua ngentelpen a khosa Pharisai ka hihdan a-ut ualeh ahon genpih thei uhi.
Pathian in ka pipute uh kiang a thu achiam lametna ziak in tu in hiai ah vai hawmsak in ka dingh hi.
Huai thuchiam lametna ziak in ka nam uh sawm-le-nih in, sun leh zan in Pathian nna phatuamngaitak a sem in muh alamen uhi. Kumpipa aw, huai lametna tungthu ah Judate'n ahon hek uhi.
Pathian in misite akaithou ding chih bangchidan a thil hi thei lou a ngaihtuah na hi ua?
"Kei mahmah in Nazaret Jesu min kalh a hihtheih teng hih thil hoih hi in ka na ngaihtuah hi.
Huai bang Jerusalem ah leng ka hih zel hi; siampu liante kiang a thu mu in, misiangthoute lak a mi tampi suangkul ah ka khum zel hi; ahihlup lai un lemsa lam ah leng ka na pang zel hi.
Huan sinagog teng ah ka sawi gige a, Jesu thu gensiatsak ka tum teitei hi. Huan atung uah ka gilou mahmah a, gamdang khuate tanpha in leng ka sawi zel hi.
"Huchibang a hih ding in siampu liante thu mu in leh asawlna lai uh tawi in Damaskas ah ka hoh hi.
heading: Paul in Apianthak Thu Agen / (Nas 9.1-19; 26.12-18)

paite: Kumpipa aw, huchi a ka pai lai in sun laitak in, nisa vak sang a vakphazaw van a kipan in keimah leh ka paipihte kim ah hong vak ka mu hi.
Ka vek un lei ah ka puk ua, Hebru pau in, 'Saul, Saul, nang bang achia hon sawi? Sutna chiangzum tot nang dia na ahi,' hon chi in ka za hi.
Ke'n, 'Toupa, kua na hia?' ka chi hi. Toupa'n, 'Na sawi, Jesu ka hi,' achi hi.
Himahleh thou inla dingh in; hiai na thil muhte leh na kiang a ka hon lah lai dingte sem ding leh theihpih dia sikha a nang hon bawl ding in na kiang ah ka hong kilak ahi.
Mi tengteng leh ka hon sawlna mite, Zentelte khut a kipan ka hon humhing ding;

amit uh hihvak ding in akiang uah ka hon sawl ahi, huchi in mial a pan vak lam anga ding ua, Setan thuneihna Pathian lam angatsan ding uhi, khelhna ngaihdamna amuhna ding uleh ahon gintak ziak ua sehtuam siangthoute lak a goutan aneihna ding un," achi hi.
"Huaiziak in kumpipa Agrippa aw, van a kilakna ka sel kei hi.
heading: Paul In Anasep Thugen

paite: Atung in Damaskas a mite kiang ah, huan Jerusalem ah, Judia leh gam chih a mite kiang leh Zentelte kiang ah leng athilhih uh kisik a, Pathian lam angatna ding un ka hilh zaw hi.
Hiaite ziak in Judate'n tempul ah ahon man ua, hon hihlup atum uhi.

Himahleh Pathian kiang a kipan a panpihna ka muh ziak in tuni tan in mineute leh miliante kiang a thu theisak in ka om lai hi; zawlneite leh Mosi in hong tung ding achih thu kia uh lou ngal thudang gen lou in.
Huchi a, Khrist in gim athuak ding a, misi lak a kipan athohnawn ziak a mi tengteng kiang leh Zentelte kiang a vak musakpa masapen ahi ding achih thu uh," achi hi.
Huchibang a asiamna thu agen lai in, Festas in, aw ngaihtak in, "Paul, hai na hi; na theih tamna in nang hon haisak ahi," achi hi.
Himahleh Paul in, Festas hoihpen, "Hai kei veng e; thu diktak leh thu piltak ka gen zaw ahi.
Hiai thute kumpipa'n athei, akiang ah leng hangsantak in ka gen ahi; hiai thil bangmah akiang ah iim ahi kei chih diktak in ka thei hi. Hiai thu inkil kawm peuh a aguk a hih ahi kei hi.
Kumpipa Agrippa, zawlneite na gingta hia? Na gingta chih ka thei,” achi hi.
Agrippa in Paul kiang ah, "Sawt louchik sung in Khristian na hon suaksak zou dek," achi hi.
Paul in, "Sawt in tom taleh, nang kia ka chi kei, tuni a ka thu za tengteng leng keimah bang a om ding in Pathian kiang ah ka ngen ahi, hiai kolbutte chih louh ngal," achita hi.
Huan thu agen zoh in kumpipa adingtou a, gam-ukpa, Barnis leh akiang ua tute leng adingh chiat uhi.
Apaituam ua akihou ua, “Hiai mi'n sihna leh kolbutna khop hial thil bangmah ahih kei,” achi uhi.
Agrippa in Festas kiang ah, "Hiai mi'n Kaisar kiang a tut ding na ngen lou hileh pawt mai ding hiven,” achi hi.
